sources.note: Guided by Gut (GG) replaces external Process Reward Models in tree-search test-time scaling with the LLM's own intrinsic token-probability confidence, calibrated via a GRPO reward that heavily penalizes overconfident wrong answers (penalty in [-9,1] vs. reward in [1,2] for correct ones), letting a 1.5B-7B model match or exceed models 10-70x larger while using 4-10x less GPU memory and 8x faster inference than PRM-guided search.
sources.title: Guided by Gut: Efficient Test-Time Scaling with Reinforced Intrinsic Confidence

sources.note: BloomEval maps each step of an LRM's reasoning trace onto Bloom's six-level cognitive taxonomy (Remember through Create) via a Cognitive Hierarchy Trace (CHT), defining structural anomalies -- hierarchy break (reasoning never reaches the required cognitive level), hierarchy jump (skipping intermediate levels), and overthinking (invoking cognitive operations exceeding what the task needs) -- and finds these anomalies are common even in *correct* answers (e.g. Grok-3 shows a 0.185 hierarchy-jump rate on correct answers), demonstrating that answer accuracy alone cannot detect incoherent or wasteful reasoning structure.
sources.title: BloomEval: A Bloom’s Cognitive Taxonomy-Based Benchmark for Evaluating LRMs via Cognitive Hierarchy Trace
